value.text: L.C.C. U.T.C. DUCTS TO LOOP BOXES (50mm)
TPRS - TRAFFIC POLE RETENTION SOCKET INSTEAD OF BOX
NOTE: ALL FEEDER PILLARS ARE SUPPLIED BY U.T.C OR SIGNALS CONTRACTOR AND INSTALLED BY CIVILS CONTRACTOR
(Use Type CDB if adjacent Combined Drainage and Kerb Block)
SUFFIX (E) DENOTES DUCT THROUGH EXISTING CARRIAGEWAY

Note: All Traffic Pole Retention Sockets are to be collected from the Employer’s Traffic Signals Installation Contractor to ensure compatibility with the signal poles that the Contractor proposes to install.
EXISTING U.T.C. DUCTS TO REMAIN UNLESS OTHERWISE ADVISED BY ENGINEER ON SITE
EXISTING U.T.C. DUCTS OR CHAMBERS TO BE REMOVED

1.	ANY DEVIATION FROM THIS DESIGN MUST BE CHECKED AND APPROVED BY THE UTMC DESIGN ENGINEER PRIOR TO INSTALLATION.
2.	POLE POSITIONS TO BE MARKED ON SITE BY UTMC ENGINEER.
3.	DUCT RUNS ARE FIR INDICATIVE PURPOSES ONLY.
4.	450 X 450 CHAMBERS TO BE USED FOR LINK DUCT CARRIAGEWAY CROSSING
TOUCAN NEARSIDE PUSH BUTTON & INDICATOR WITH REPEATER & TACTILE KNOB
